name: Type E (CEE 7/5, CEE 7/6)
description: Household plug and socket system with two round 4.8 mm pins and a male earth pin projecting from the socket-outlet; the plug has a matching earth hole. The earth pin makes earthed plugs polarised in this socket. The CEE 7/7 hybrid plug fits both type E and type F sockets.
